2026-07-22 23:22:36.354853 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-22 23:22:36.354858 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-07-22 23:22:36.354869 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
